newsitem.title: USA: Ashland Minnesota crude unit down - source.
newsitem.headline: Ashland Minnesota crude unit down - source.

text.p: The 37,000 barrels-per-day crude unit at Ashland Oil's Minnesota refinery has been shut down after sustaining minor damages during a fire on Friday, an informed source said.
The unit at the 70,000 bpd St Paul Park refinery was taken down after the fire broke out in the plant's sewer system Friday afternoon.
Ashland officials said earlier Monday that a unit at the plant had been damaged, but would not disclose which one. They would not disclose how capacity had been affected.
"The unit that is down sustained minor damages. I cannot confirm or deny which one," said an Ashland spokesman, Chuck Rice.
Rice said the cause of the fire was still unknown.
A state envirnomental official earlier Monday said the problem appeared to be with one of the crude unit heaters after what local news reports called an explosion at the facility.
